entities.name: PMID:25088053
observations: In allergic airway models, FcRγ-associated receptor signaling in dendritic cells induced IL-33 and drove ST2-dependent TH2 inflammation.
IgG immune complexes used FcγRIII, whereas house-dust-mite extract used Dectin-2; both required FcRγ.
FcRγ-sufficient allergen-pulsed BM-derived DC transfer and exogenous IL-33 rescued responses in FcRγ-deficient settings.

entities.name: PMID:23585480
observations: IgG immune-complex-induced allergic lung TH2 inflammation required FcγRIII, TLR4, and ST2/IL-33 signaling.
FcγRIII activation increased IL-33 in BM-derived DCs, alveolar macrophages, and respiratory DCs.

entities.name: PMID:34305908
observations: Dectin-1 stimulation suppressed TSLP-induced myeloid-DC OX40L/CCL17 and allergen-specific TH2 responses in the reported context.

entities.name: PMID:35354044
observations: Prolonged Dectin-1 signaling induced DC IL-33 through SYK–PLCγ–CARD9–ERK, with TH9 rather than the core FcRγ-associated TH2 outcome reported.

entities.name: PMID:31251950
observations: In human APCs, TSLP increased FCER1G/FcRγ-related receptor expression and Dectin-2 neutralization attenuated TH2/TH17 polarization; a direct IL-33 causal step was not established.

entities.name: FCER1G
observations: FcRγ adaptor required for the reported dendritic-cell IL-33-dependent TH2 response in allergic airway models.

entities.name: FCGR3
observations: FcγRIII mediated IgG immune-complex signaling upstream of myeloid-cell IL-33 and ST2-dependent TH2 airway inflammation.

entities.name: CLEC6A
observations: Dectin-2 mediated house-dust-mite/allergen signaling through FcRγ in the central dendritic-cell mechanism; related human APC evidence linked it to TH2/TH17 polarization.

entities.name: IL33
observations: FcRγ-associated receptor signaling induced IL-33 in dendritic and other lung myeloid cells; IL-33/ST2 signaling was required for TH2 airway inflammation in the key models.

entities.name: IL1RL1
observations: ST2/IL1RL1 deficiency abolished the reported IL-33-dependent allergic TH2 response.
